Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR-frame body animation sprite sheet for a floating demon god boss, true transparent alpha, square canvas with EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows of EQUAL square cells. Read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each cell ONE complete character. The image supplied is the ONLY canonical reference: preserve its exact head shape, black-violet muscular body, gold armor edges, red chest core, dark crimson split waistcloth, oblique golden-black halo, two arms and two legs, proportions, pixel palette and fine JRPG pixel-art clusters. Keep the character strictly facing LEFT at the same 60-degree three-quarter angle in ALL frames. Preserve the canonical ornate antique-gold outer head frame and TOP/REAR three-pronged architectural crown crest; the front plane stays blank obsidian, no eye-like jewels. Exactly TWO muscular arms with a traceable shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand connection; no extra arms, duplicated fists, disconnected hands, or anatomy formed by VFX. Two bent hanging legs with relaxed pointed feet: this is floating, never walking or planting feet. Clear full-body silhouette in every cell, equal body scale and lighting. Do not let the cloth or halo turn into extra limbs. Full halo must stay behind torso, never clipped. Same non-glowing dark halo except tiny brightness change on cast; no large VFX baked into body, no ground, shadows, scenery, fog, glow backdrop, particles, labels, grid or watermark. Crisp stepped pixel edges and dark outlines, no smooth painting/3D. Coordinates below are normalized per cell from 0 to 1000, fixed origin top-left. Keep every visible pixel inside x=100..900,y=100..900, at least 8% TRANSPARENT space at every cell edge and a clear transparent separator along sheet center. Scale the reference to a full silhouette HEIGHT of about 720 units including halo and feet. Neutral pelvis ROOT (550,555); blank head (430,235); chest core (475,380); near shoulder (455,355), far shoulder (630,360); neutral near fist (345,530), far fist (660,530); near knee (480,695), far knee (595,710); feet (495,845),(605,860). Keep body height/proportions constant; motions articulate joints rather than resize the character. No detached energy limbs or extra poses. This sheet is body motion only; existing separate effects will be reused.
Motion: 浮遊移動
Per-frame trajectory (MANDATORY): LEFTWARD gliding LOOP, no locomotion stepping and no horizontal travel within the sheet (game translates sprite). Constant forward torso lean 8 degrees versus reference, hips/root stays x=550. Both bent lower legs trail toward RIGHT +35 units, cloth streams RIGHT +30. F1 neutral height; F2 root UP12, cloth lags down8; F3 neutral height, knees float +6; F4 root DOWN12, cloth lags up8.
